title: Term Life Insurance: End of the Accidental Death Benefit Rider at Its Expiry Age
content:
**Rider administration — Term Life Insurance.**

The accidental death rider ends on the policy anniversary at which the insured's anniversary age reaches the product's accidental death rider expiry age; Ashgrove then removes the rider amount and sets the installment after the accidental death rider ends from the premium components on record.

The installment after the accidental death rider ends is not set until the policy status on record has moved from lapsed back to in force.

| Business effect | After the rider ends |
|---|---|
| Accidental death rider amount | zero |
| Installment premium | the installment after the accidental death rider ends |

## Invocation: `end_expired_adb_rider_b05b3f4a`

**Capability.** Removes the accidental death benefit rider from one Ashgrove term policy and records its new installment: the policy's accidental death rider amount becomes zero and its installment premium becomes the amount supplied.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool. Unlock it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then call it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `term_policy_id` | The reference number of the term policy whose accidental death rider ends, read from the term policy lookup before the call | Identifier, as recorded |
| `new_modal_premium` | The installment premium to record once the rider is removed | USD, a non-negative amount with 2 decimal places; the tool rounds half to even to the cent if more are given |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` ("rider_removed" on success), `term_policy_id`, `adb_rider_amount` (always 0.0, USD) and `modal_premium` (USD with 2 decimal places). Afterwards the policy record shows no accidental death rider and the new installment premium.
